messages.content: Validate whether a candidate stays within STORY. Harmless presentation/execution detail is allowed when it does not materially change events, relationships, danger, objects central to plot, or outcome. Return valid JSON only.

STORY:
Amy cooks breakfast for Will and Amber on a normal morning.

CANDIDATE:
Amy cooks pancakes and eggs, plates the food, and serves breakfast to Will and Amber.

Choose one validity value from: VALID, INVALID.
Return a JSON object with keys "validity" and "issue".
